units.rawText: I was once unaware of my own sins, but after she showed up, I came to realize what pain and suffering truly was.

spans.text: I was once unaware of my own sins, but after she showed up, I came to realize what pain and suffering truly was.

units.rawText: I finally learned the weight of shame and regret, and I realized why she longed for salvation. However... I'm afraid I no longer have any chances to absolve sins any further.

units.rawText: What I do now, I do to try and make up for the past. The past can't be erased, but at least, I have to stop the gears of tragedy from moving any further... don't you agree?
